Name: Electric Chain
Description: You create a binding chain of lightning energy that strikes at one creature of your choice that you can see within 15 feet of you. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 10 feet in a straight line towards you and then take 1d8 lightning damage if it is within 5 feet of you.
At Higher Levels: This spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8). The spell's range also increases by 5 feet at each of these points (20 feet at 5th level, 25 feet at 11th level, and 30 feet at 17th level). At 11th level the chain can pull creatures 15 feet closer instead of 10.
Sourcebook: Lyres Guide to Retia - Land of Industry
